scientific_integrity: Self-contained uniform local-classification and explicit collapse proof; finite checker separately confirms several cases, without claiming independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Rectangular twisted grids with m,n at least seven; inclusive shortest-path scale two only. No theorem for smaller sizes, other scales or arbitrary continuous Klein-bottle samples; possible unindexed equivalent prior literature.
title: An explicit simplicial collapse of twisted grid Rips complexes to the Klein bottle
